text:
samir: quick onboarding Q — took notes during infra onboarding. where's the right place to put them so they become canonical? unsure if i should keep under My Pages or create directly in the team space.

marta-devex: hey Samir! if they're purely personal learning notes, keep them in My Pages. if you think they should be part of the official runbook, create the page and tag me — i'll review and migrate/merge into /Team Docs -> Engineering -> Infra -> Runbooks. canonical runbooks live at https://redwood.notion.so/eng-infra-runbooks

samir: i tried to create a new page under that space but the New button is greyed out for me — looks like i don't have editor rights on the Team Docs space

kelly: yup that means you're a Viewer for that workspace or the parent page has restrictions. two ways to fix: 1) Open the target page, click Share -> Request access and notify @marta-devex. 2) Use our internal access queue curl helper: ```bash
curl -X POST https://internal.redwood.tools/doc-access -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"page":"https://redwood.notion.so/eng-infra-runbooks","user":"samir"}'
```
we'll approve from the queue.

marta-devex: granted you Editor on that runbooks page — also a couple of housekeeping items: use templates from /Templates/engineering for runbooks (don't copy large page trees). templates keep metadata and properties intact.

samir: cool, thanks. is there a naming convention we should follow? i have a local page titled "infra-setup-notes"

kelly: we prefer titles with the team slug and date like: `eng-infra YYYY-MM-DD brief title` (eg. "eng-infra 2026-03-23 oncall-runbook"). in Notion make it human readable but include the prefix for searchability. set the page property Status: Draft while it's being reviewed.

samir: if i create under My Pages, can it be moved later without losing comments/backlinks?

marta-devex: yes — use Move to... in the page menu and choose the destination. comments and backlinks are preserved. if you'd rather i move it, add me as a viewer and drop the link here.

devex-bot: Access change: marta-devex granted Editor access to samir on /Team Docs/Engineering/Infra/Runbooks (approved via internal queue)

samir: thanks! i'll copy the notes into a draft and ping for review when ready :thumbsup:

(reacted with :white_check_mark: by kelly)
